00339359a51ae1134b55538609bed26a6f6516c1.author: Azzinoth
00339359a51ae1134b55538609bed26a6f6516c1.message: Updated Focal Engine submodule to the latest version; Selection halo effect is now turned off while nothing is selected, previously its five stages ran every frame; Gizmos are no longer drawn black, the fix is in the engine; Content Browser no longer shows Dear ImGui error when it has nothing to show (empty directory or a filter that matches nothing); Added FEVirtualFileSystem::CreateMissingFiles; Resources with a name that is taken are now added to virtual file system with their type or ID added to the name, on project load and on import, previously they were left out of content browser; FEProject::AddMissingVFSData now collects files and names once, previously it searched the whole tree for every resource.

79de45d8cdaa11269c9737b41eee82bb2e8288b4.message: Updated Focal Engine submodule to the latest version; Previews are now made when they are first shown, previously all of them were rendered when a project was opened; A changed material now updates only previews that exist, of the material, of game models and of prefabs that use it; Removed FEEditorPreviewManager::ReCreateAll.

7ed918d6996d898d26f3b04f13bacbcfc1f7e488.author: Azzinoth
7ed918d6996d898d26f3b04f13bacbcfc1f7e488.message: Updated Focal Engine submodule to the latest version; FEProject now creates Shaders directory of virtual file system when it is missing, previously a new project logged an error for every shader; Debug window and Temporary debug window are now hidden until turned on in Window > Debug; Game mode is now run with a play button at the top center of the main window, previously with a button in Debug window; Gizmo buttons are moved to the top right corner of scene window; Added Project menu with Build executable, Build button is removed from main.cpp.

9a722bce2e3bfdc14a97f1e32f39dea647a1edcb.author: Azzinoth
9a722bce2e3bfdc14a97f1e32f39dea647a1edcb.message: Updated Focal Engine submodule to the latest version; FEEditorPreviewManager now uses AABB returned by FEAABB::Transform to center mesh, game model and point cloud in preview, previously result was ignored, so objects with geometry far from their origin were out of frame; FEEditorPreviewManager::CreateMaterialPreview now updates previews of game models that use material once, previously it did it twice; FEEditorPreviewManager::CreateMeshPreview no longer loops through all game models, that loop compared materials instead of meshes and never updated anything; Removed FEEditorPreviewManager::CheckAndUpdateIfNeededGameModelPreview; FEEditorPreviewManager::ReCreateAll now skips game models that already got preview from their material; FEEditorPreviewManager::GetMaterialPreview no longer updates game model and prefab previews second time after CreateMaterialPreview; FEEditorPreviewManager::GetGameModelPreview no longer updates previews of all game models when material of game model is dirty, CreateMaterialPreview already updates game models that use that material.

commit.author: Azzinoth
commit.message: Updated Focal Engine submodule to the latest version; FEEditorPreviewManager now uses AABB returned by FEAABB::Transform to center mesh, game model and point cloud in preview, previously result was ignored, so objects with geometry far from their origin were out of frame; FEEditorPreviewManager::CreateMaterialPreview now updates previews of game models that use material once, previously it did it twice; FEEditorPreviewManager::CreateMeshPreview no longer loops through all game models, that loop compared materials instead of meshes and never updated anything; Removed FEEditorPreviewManager::CheckAndUpdateIfNeededGameModelPreview; FEEditorPreviewManager::ReCreateAll now skips game models that already got preview from their material; FEEditorPreviewManager::GetMaterialPreview no longer updates game model and prefab previews second time after CreateMaterialPreview; FEEditorPreviewManager::GetGameModelPreview no longer updates previews of all game models when material of game model is dirty, CreateMaterialPreview already updates game models that use that material.
